name: Pope Sylvester I
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 314 to 335
contribution: The bishop of Rome from 31 January 314 until his death on 31 December 335.

checks.lead: Pope Sylvester I (also Silvester, before 284 – 31 December 335) was the bishop of Rome from 31 January 314 until his death on 31 December 335. He filled the See of Rome at an important era in the history of the Western Church, though very little is known of his life.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
